en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a dense European port city with a busy waterfront lined with ferries and small ships, curving quays, mid‑rise blocks, and some areas under construction cut into rocky terrain. A large green park with tree‑lined avenues stretches inland, surrounded by blocks of 19th‑ and early‑20th‑century buildings. Overprinted purple text and a red frame line appear on the image, suggesting it is a proof or archive copy of a postcard view.
